verdict.rationale: Poly's docs show only fragments of this story: journal entries are Markdown files that can carry attached files, and the file editor offers Vim keybindings, which hints at a keyboard-driven Markdown editing surface. Nothing documents the formatting features the story names or the editor experience itself. Missing for 10: documented support for headings, callouts, tables, code blocks and inline embedded media; evidence of editor speed or keyboard shortcuts beyond Vim mode; hands-on or independent corroboration.
